items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: Al Dow, another local trombone player in Pittsburgh, who is one of the first people that allowed me to come up and sit in

ctx.x: He’s still playing. They just had Slide Hampton in Pittsburgh about a month ago and there they had Harold Betters and Al Dow, another local trombone player in Pittsburgh, who is one of the first people that allowed me to come up and sit in and be receptive to us. We couldn’t play you know. I’m from Wheeling, West Virginia originally so the big city to us was Pittsburgh. We would drive up, go to Al Dow’s jam session and then drive back to West Virginia you know. And Al would let us on stage. He would welcome us…
Yeah. That’s a great thing to capture.
